findings.title: The AC naming six owning tickets is reported done against a different set of tickets, and five of the six own no locatable activity-feed cell
findings.evidence: Ticket line (#861 Agent Brief, Acceptance criteria): "- [ ] The activity-feed cells owned by #625, #633, #639, #646, #647 and #650 still pass." The report (reports/wave2-lane08-ticket861.md, AC table row 3) marks it done and cites "The same run covers #632's, #728's, #630's, #770's and #840's own cells" -- a disjoint set of ticket numbers. Measured on the branch: grep for #625|#633|#639|#646|#647|#650 over apps/web/components/firm/activity, apps/web/lib/firm/activity.ts, apps/web/lib/firm/activity.test.ts, packages/db/tests/activity-feed.test.mjs, apps/web/e2e/activity-mock.mjs and apps/web/e2e/activity-feed-walk.spec.ts returns NOTHING. Of the six, only #650 owns a spec that mentions activity at all (apps/web/e2e/home-board-walk.spec.ts), and that is the one walk the implementer ran (27 passed). The walks owned by #625/#633/#639/#646/#647 (members-invite, documents-intake, fixed-asset-acquisition, document-correction, counterparty-identity) contain no reference to the activity feed and were not run -- defensible, but the report never says so.
findings.required_fix: Either name, per ticket, the cells the AC means and the run that covered them, or record in the report that five of the six tickets own no activity-feed cell on this branch and that the AC is satisfied by the whole apps/web unit suite plus af.1-af.39b plus home-board-walk. The AC holds substantively; what is missing is the traceability it asks for.

findings.title: Both #840 and #861 instruct that the two door recuts land in ONE migration; two separate recuts landed and neither report names the instruction or the rule that overrides it
findings.evidence: #840 triage comment (2026-09-17): "If #861 (the kind ladder) is in flight at the same time, land the two recuts in one migration rather than two." #861 owner ruling (2026-09-18): "#840 recuts the same two doors: land the two in one migration if both are in flight." Both were in flight in the same lane. The branch lands 0262_activity_successor_link.sql and 0264_activity_kind_ladder.sql, each a create-or-replace of BOTH clara.list_activity and clara.get_activity_event (0262 lines 355/637; 0264 lines 444-449/738-743). grep for 'one migration', 'in flight' or 'coordinate' over all three lane reports returns nothing. The wave-2 WORK-ORDER addendum does override the ticket line ("A ticket that needs a schema or function change writes EXACTLY ONE new migration file at the number reserved for it in your prompt"; "One implementer per ticket"), and the sequencing is handled correctly: 0264's prestate pins 0262's OUTPUT shas (186ab1af.../37319708...) rather than 0202/0184's, and both bodies were rebuilt from 0262's committed text. The outcome is sound; the silence is the finding.
findings.required_fix: Record in the #840 and #861 reports that the ticket's one-migration line was superseded by the wave-2 addendum's one-migration-per-ticket rule, and that 0264 pins 0262's post-state so the two recuts compose. No code change.

findings.evidence: Commit a60a3f40d ("fix(web): DocumentKindDialog's trigger items referenced undefined DOCUMENT_KINDS") changes apps/web/components/documents/document-kind-dialog.tsx, a file outside the briefs of #840, #843 and #861. findings.title: The owner ruling's "the implementer writes both language files" and its suggested Chinese labels are neither used nor addressed
findings.evidence: #861 owner ruling (2026-09-18): "Suggested labels: People / Assets / Counterparties / Clients / Firm in Chinese (the implementer writes both language files)." The branch writes English labels only, into apps/web/messages/en.json. Measured: apps/web/messages/ contains en.json alone, and apps/web/i18n/request.ts:91 pins const locale = "en", its header stating "a single static locale, no locale-prefixed routing... Adding en-GB/ms/zh later is a routing.ts + middleware change". So there is no second language file to write and the instruction is unsatisfiable as stated. reports/wave2-lane08-ticket861.md never mentions the ruling's label suggestion or the second file.
findings.required_fix: Record in the report that the estate is single-locale (apps/web/i18n/request.ts:91), so "both language files" resolves to en.json alone, and that the English labels are the implementer's rendering of the ruling's five names. If the owner wants the Chinese strings on record for a later locale, that is a separate ticket.

findings.title: The feed row and the detail Sheet disagree about a successor on a row with no client: the row renders nothing, the Sheet renders unlinked text
findings.evidence: #840's brief: "The feed renders it as a second deep link" -- with no client caveat. apps/web/components/firm/activity/activity-row.tsx gates on {row.client_id && row.successor_work_id ? <Link .../> : null}, so a successor on a row with a null client_id vanishes entirely; apps/web/components/firm/activity/activity-event-sheet.tsx gates on {detail.successor_work_id ? ...} and falls back to t("linksToSuccessor") as plain text when detail.client_id is null. Latent today, measured on clara_l08: clara.event_types carries work.cancelled with client_scoped = true, so the row always has a client. Neither report names the divergence.
findings.required_fix: None required while work.cancelled stays client-scoped. If the pair is touched again, make the row fall back the way the Sheet does (or make both drop the field), and say in the report that the two surfaces are deliberately different.
